text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Ben Ali visit to Argentina on March 24-26 was a big success and gave bilateral cooperation a new impetus. Tunisian and Argentinian businessmen met to discuss trade and investments opportunities.
- Police arrest the alleged killer of Italian woman Milena Bianchi missing since 1995.
- A Qatari university delegation is in Tunis to hire Tunisian scholars.
